summary: The text argues against cutting E-Rate funding, emphasizing the importance of libraries and schools in American society and the negative impact of funding cuts on these institutions.

claims.argument: Funding cuts have affected schools and libraries across the country, greatly so in Indiana. Dissolving the financially help erate provides to schools and libraries puts an additional undue amount of stress on these organizations.
